g.text: TREBUCHET WOOD CUTOUT SHAPES & CUTTING SCHEDULE
1:1 & DIMENSIONED WORKSHOP CUTTING PATTERNS • EXTRACTED DIRECTLY FROM Trebuchet_3ft.obj
MATERIAL: STRAIGHT-GRAIN PINE / HARDWOOD LUMBER • KERF ALLOWANCE: 1/8" (3.2 mm)
TOLERANCE: ± 1/32" [± 0.8 mm] • ALL ANGLES CALIBRATED FOR PERFECT A-FRAME CONVERGENCE
• W2-R (Rear), W2-M (Mid), W2-F (Front) form rigid base ladder.
• Upper cross tie omitted to ensure 100% free swingarm rotation.
[W4-LF, LR, RF, RR] A-FRAME ANGLED POSTS (QTY: 4) — 3/4" x 1.5" x 31.8" STOCK (30.6" C-C)
[W5-L, W5-R] BEARING PILLOW BLOCKS (QTY: 2) — 1.5" x 3.0" x 2.17" [38.1 x 76.2 x 55.0 mm]
• Pocket: Ø 22.0 mm (+0.1/-0.0) x 7.0 mm Deep (Press-fit for 608 Bearing)
• Center Bore: Ø 8.5 mm (11/32") Through-hole for 8.0 mm steel axle clearance
• Base Mount: 2x Ø 1/4" Holes tapped/bolted into A-Frame apex header
[W6] MARBLE GUIDE TROUGH STRIP (QTY: 1) — 1/2" x 2.0" x 21.94" [12.7 x 50.8 x 557.2 mm]
21.94" [557.2 mm] FINISHED LENGTH (MOUNTED ON TOP OF CROSSBARS)
[W7] BIGGER SWINGARM BEAM (QTY: 1) — 1.5" x 1.5" x 40.00" TIMBER [38.1 x 38.1 x 1016.0 mm]
MASTER WOOD CUTTING SCHEDULE & WORKSHOP FABRICATION BILL
Mounted on Top of Crossbars; Route Ø16mm groove
• Miter Saw or Hand Backsaw with Miter Box (must hold 17.1° / 72.9° angle accurately).
• Drill Press or Hand Drill with bits: Ø 8.0 mm (fulcrum axle), Ø 8.5 mm (bearing clearance),
Ø 22.0 mm (7/8" Forstner bit for 608 bearing recess), Ø 3/8" (counterweight bolt), Ø 3/16" (sling pin).
• Router or Table with Ø 5/8" (16 mm) round-nose / core-box bit for the marble trough track.
Step A: Assemble Base Frame: Clamp W1-L & W1-R runners to W2-R, W2-M, W2-F crossbars. Bolt and glue.
Step B: Build Side A-Frames: Fasten dual angled posts (W4-LF & W4-LR) at base runners and apex.
Step C: Mount Pillow Blocks: Press-fit 608 bearings into W5 blocks; bolt blocks securely to A-frame apex.
Step D: Hang Swingarm: Slide 8mm steel axle through left bearing, swingarm pivot hole, and right bearing.
Step E: Rig Sling & Trough: Screw W6 trough ON TOP of Crossbar_Rear and Crossbar_Mid; rig leather sling.
Step F: Calibrate Counterweight: Screw 748g disc stack to short arm bolt; test launch 16mm marble.
ALL 13 CUTTING PIECES DERIVED FROM EXACT 3D VERTICES OF Trebuchet_3ft.obj (UPPER TIE OMITTED FOR SWINGARM CLEARANCE)
~22 Linear Feet 3/4" x 1.5" + 4.0 Ft 1.5" x 1.5" Timber
